components.name: Primary Button (Ocean Default)
components.description: Primary form submission or view CTA driven by --primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:36px; padding:0 16px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid transparent; background:var(--primary,#0369a1); color:var(--primary-foreground,#ffffff); font-size:13px; font-weight:500; transition:opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity:0.9; }

components.name: Destructive Outline Button
components.description: Row-level Remove, Unlink, and Revoke triggers with accessible crimson tint.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:28px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid rgba(201,42,42,0.45); background:rgba(201,42,42,0.06); color:#c92a2a; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; } .ds-btn-danger-outline:hover { background:rgba(201,42,42,0.12); border-color:rgba(201,42,42,0.7); }

components.name: Tailscale-Style Collapsible Nav Leaf
components.description: Active route leaf nested under a 1px vertical guide hairline.
components.css: .ds-nav-tree { margin-left:19px; padding-left:12px; border-left:1px solid #dcdad3; } .ds-nav-leaf { display:flex; align-items:center; height:32px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; color:#5e5d58; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-leaf.active { background:#e6f0f6; color:#075985; font-weight:500; }

narrative.overview: EdgeBase pairs calm Dieter Rams / Braun product catalog clarity with Tailscale-style tonal consistency and structured tree hierarchy, anchored by Ocean Blue default chroma and live primary color customization.
keyCharacteristics: Unified all-light (#FFFFFF on #F3F2EE) and all-dark (#141518 on #111214) rail polarity.
Default Ocean Blue (#0369A1 / #0EA5E9) primary accent with live 8-preset + custom hex selector.
Tailscale-inspired collapsible Push notifications tree with clean geometric icons and zero BellRing clutter.
Centered 440px Auth Portal with balanced 3-column OAuth buttons and direct WebAuthn passkey prompts.

rules.name: The Unified Tonal Parity Rule
rules.body: Sidebar and workspace maintain consistent light or dark polarity without dark-on-light contrast splits.

rules.name: The Live AA Accent Rule
rules.body: User-selected accent colors compute WCAG AA (>= 4.6:1) foreground ink dynamically.

rules.name: The Destructive Separation Rule
rules.body: All removal, revocation, and unlink actions use semantic Crimson variants.

dos: Do keep light mode all-light (#FFFFFF rail + #F3F2EE ground) and dark mode all-dark (#141518 rail + #111214 ground).
Do route theme and accent changes through setThemePreference and setAccentPreference.
Do mark removal and revocation buttons with crimson destructive variants.
donts: Don't add decorative marketing side panels beside centered authentication sheets.
Don't wrap template keys, locales, user IDs, or {{variables}} in bordered pill boxes.
Don't use BellRing glyphs or uppercase eyebrows above headings.
